customers.name: Independent Brand Founder
customers.description: A founder or two-person team selling their own products online, often starting from social media, marketplaces or markets. They run design, merchandising, fulfillment, support and bookkeeping themselves and need a store that works on day one, gets them paid quickly, and grows without hiring an operations team.
careAbout: Launching a credible store quickly without a developer
Low, predictable fixed costs while revenue is uncertain
Getting paid fast and seeing cash clearly
Turning social followers and first buyers into repeat customers
Spending time on product and brand, not admin
winsThem: A free trial that ends with a real first sale
Themes, apps and AI help that make the store look established
Built-in payments, shipping labels and taxes with no separate contracts
Capital offers based on their own sales history
One admin and mobile app that runs the whole business
theirFear: Paying for a store that never gets traffic
Stacking app subscriptions and transaction fees that eat thin margins
Payout holds, chargebacks or fraud wiping out a month's profit
Being stuck on a platform they will outgrow

customers.name: Enterprise Omnichannel Retail Director
customers.description: VP of digital and store technology at an established retailer or brand with hundreds of stores and a wholesale business. Accountable for unifying point of sale, online, and B2B ordering on one stack integrated with ERP, warehouse and finance systems.
careAbout: One view of inventory, customers and orders across stores, web and wholesale
Store staff productivity and uptime on the shop floor
Integration with ERP, warehouse management and finance
Security, compliance and procurement approval
Reducing the number of commerce systems to maintain
winsThem: Point of sale and online on the same order, customer and inventory model
Native B2B with company accounts, price lists and payment terms
Stable APIs, webhooks and partner-led ERP connectors
Hardware and payments bundled with the POS software
Composable use of components alongside existing systems
theirFear: Store downtime on a peak trading day
A long integration program that stalls in year two
Losing wholesale-specific features buyers depend on
Data residency or compliance gaps discovered late

customers.description: A consumer who buys regularly from independent and DTC brands on phone, increasingly starting in social feeds or AI assistants. They never think about the platform, but notice a fast saved checkout, reliable tracking and easy returns.
careAbout: Paying in one tap without retyping card and address
Trusting a brand they have never bought from
Knowing where every order is
Easy returns and responsive support
Finding products through conversation, not endless browsing
winsThem: A saved wallet that works across thousands of stores
Order tracking for all purchases in one place
Pay-in-installments at checkout where it fits
Assistants that can find and buy the right product
theirFear: Card details stolen by an unknown store
Parcels that never arrive with no one to contact
Return fees and confusing return processes

Breaking API changes forcing unpaid rework
Agencies losing work to AI-generated stores
